dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave spline along the trailing edge, featuring a distinct irregular notch in the upper third of the margin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded classification with a medium pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree incline relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.4:1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Low-profile convex arc with a broad radius.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, blunt rostrum with a low length-to-thickness ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Highly obtuse angle (approx. 160 degrees) at the transition point from melon to rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single V-shaped notch on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin; scattered light-colored linear raking marks and circular depigmentation spots on the mid-lateral flank and melon.
other_distinctive_markers: Mottled, non-uniform pigmentation pattern across the dorsal and lateral surfaces.
